sites.name: West Lake Of The Isles Parkway

notes: Income: ACS B19301 2020-2024 per-capita income in 2024 dollars. Native census tract geography; never averaged into neighborhoods.

Traffic: 2024 MnDOT AADT history joined by LOCATION_ID to current sites, filtered COMMUNITY=Minneapolis, unique point-in-neighborhood match. Includes measured and modeled records. AADT is annual average daily traffic, not snow-day traffic.
Historical locations without a current geometry and boundary ambiguities are omitted and reported.
